name: Spirit in the Ball
note: Madame Zara's spirit floats inside the crystal ball and chants friendly spooky rhymes.
head: Using the woman in the reference picture as the character (Madame Zara: deep violet head wrap with gold stars, gold hoop earrings, kind face), paint only her head and the very top of her neck as a friendly ghostly spirit. Front-facing, looking straight at the viewer, calm and kind, eyes open, lips gently closed. Soft luminous skin with a gentle violet and teal ghostly glow; her neck fades away into thin wisps of mist. Pure solid black background with nothing else in the picture. The head is centred and fills about 55% of the picture height, with plenty of black space all around. Painterly storybook style, magical and kind, not scary. No text, no frame, no border, no crystal ball.

variants.mouth-mid: Edit this picture. Keep everything exactly the same: same face, same head position and size, same lighting, same black background. Change only her mouth: lips slightly parted, as if in the middle of saying a word.
variants.mouth-open: Edit this picture. Keep everything exactly the same: same face, same head position and size, same lighting, same black background. Change only her mouth: open in a round 'oh' shape, as if chanting 'ooooh', showing a small dark open mouth.
variants.blink: Edit this picture. Keep everything exactly the same: same face, same head position and size, same lighting, same black background. Change only her eyes: gently closed, as if blinking.

style: ethereal and otherworldly, a kind spirit speaking slowly from inside a crystal ball, mysterious incantation with a sing-song rhythm, warm rather than scary

scenes.title: The spirit awakens
scenes.line: <long pause> Ooooh... <breath> Who knocks upon my crystal door? <short pause> Come closer, little ones. Madame Zara's spirit awakens once more!

scenes.title: Candles flicker
scenes.line: Candles flicker, shadows creep... <short pause> owls are hooting, kittens sleep. <whispers> Knock, knock, knock upon the door... <chuckle> and treats you'll find, and maybe more!

scenes.title: Spirits of the pumpkin patch
scenes.line: Spirits of the pumpkin patch, <short pause> spirits of the attic latch... <long pause> wiggle your bones and tap your toes. <laugh> Happy Halloween, from head to nose!

scenes.title: A glimpse of the future
scenes.line: I see... <short pause> I see... <long pause> a bucket so full it will not close! <chuckle> Careful now. It's heavier than you'd suppose.

scenes.title: Back to the mist
scenes.line: The mist grows thick, the candles low... <sigh> back to the spirit world I go. <short pause> Be kind, be brave, and share your sweets... <giggle> Happy Halloween, and happy treats!
